files_archive.licence: The pack's installer is Inno Setup 6.4.2, which no extractor reads yet, so the placed files travel with the recording. What this edition places is open source (LAV Filters, MPC-HC, MPC Video Renderer, DirectVobSub: GPL) plus Icaros, which its author distributes freely.
